title: Apatite Additions
description:
Apatite Additions -
This Mod Adds a New Ore Called Apatite and This Ore can Be Created Into Multiple Different and Interesting Items (Mod Created Using MCreator)
body:
# Apatite Additions Mod 
 **This mod adds a brand-new resource to Minecraft: Apatite Ore, a valuable and versatile material that opens up new crafting possibilities! Found deep underground in the deepslate layer, Apatite Ore can be mined to obtain Apatite, which can be used in a variety of ways.**
 
**Key Features:**
Apatite Ore: This rare ore can only be found in the deepslate layer, making it a challenge to find but rewarding to mine. When mined, it drops Apatite, a valuable material for crafting powerful tools and weapons. (only drops if mined by iron and above)

**Apatite Sword:** Craft a powerful sword using Apatite, dealing more damage than typical stone or iron swords and adding a unique visual flair to your inventory.

**Apatite Glowshard:** This is only in creative at the moment and only lights on soul blocks.

**Client and Server Compatibility:**
Works on Clients and Servers: Whether you're playing solo or with friends, this mod can be added to both your Minecraft client and your server without any hassle. Enjoy the new content wherever you play!

**Future Updates:**
More Content Coming Soon: I’ll be working on adding even more exciting features, items, and content to the mod in future updates. (if you would like to see the updates on it join my discord channel)
